notes.title: Celebration & Announcing Within Somnia!
notes.content: [h1]Thank you very much for your support![/h1][p][/p][p]I created Contraindication during a time when I was unsure if I would ever be able to create again, so this game was made not with the intentions of being a “good game”, but rather as proof that I can still create. [/p][p]I did not think anyone would play it, so all of your kindness has inspired me - I never would have imagined that it would hit 20,002 licenses in a month![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596421/6443fcf2bc00a3a49a2dcf34b612ad41c567f4e1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Now for the announcement...[/h2][p][/p][p]While Contraindication was made in 11 days (where the last 3 were frantic coding), this project has been in the works for several years and is very close to my heart.[/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211390/Within_Somnia_Act/" buttoncolor="#00ff00"]Within Somnia \[Act Ø] will launch FREE on Steam[/url] - please wishlist for support![/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="Dgr1N9eN0z8;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][i]" \[   ] is company policy.  The lines begin to blur between your identity... A surreal (comedic) horror RPG with a fusion of pixel, hand-drawn, & 3D art. Fall deeper & deeper into sleep while you wait, something lies beneath the surface. "[/i][/h3][p][/p][h1]One last illustration to say goodbye, thank you for everything![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596421/18f6b8d74be80266013c1d0de8b601d7131e44fe.png"][/img][/p][p]P.S. you might see them as an easter egg in a future release of Within Somnia ;][/p]
